svg.title: Shared modules, each across the areas it replaces code in
svg.desc: Four columns: the transport, the client and monitors, the Source, the Destination. Eight shared modules, by strength of evidence, top first. 1, output and path types, across the client, Source and Destination: 17 direct writes to stderr in cli.rs, about 18 from_utf8_lossy, and shown meaning two things. 2, error classes, across Source and Destination: none in the Source, six places in the Destination. 3, the first cause, across all four: Scope.why and Core.broken, and stop.failing by hand in five places. 4, threads, spawn(role) and a shared pool, across all four: about 23 spawns in the client, 2 of them named, seven hand-written worker loops, and fixed thread counts. 5, timers and telemetry, across all four: six timed loops that each end their own way, and one set of gauges sent two ways. 6, the display pipe, in the client: one channel, six ways to send. 7, host output markers, in the transport: parsed in three places. 8, a filesystem layer of Name, Meta and TempFile, across Source and Destination: name rules twice, the parent and name split seven times, temporary files three times. Each comes with one rule a test enforces.
svg.text: 17 direct writes to stderr in cli.rs, ~18 from_utf8_lossy, shown meaning two things
none in the Source, six places in the Destination
Scope.why and Core.broken, two copies; stop.failing written by hand in five places in the peers
4. Threads: spawn(role) and a shared pool
~23 spawns in the client, 2 of them named; 7 hand-written worker loops; a fixed thread count for each stage
six timed loops that each end their own way; one set of gauges sent two ways
one channel, six ways to send
name rules twice, parent/name split 7 times, temp files 3 times
By strength of evidence, top first; under each, what it replaces. Each comes with one rule a test enforces, such as: stderr only through the way out.
